newsitem.title: USA: GM in ad deal with Sony theater - NYT.
newsitem.headline: GM in ad deal with Sony theater - NYT.

text.p: General Motors Corp is teaming up with Sony Corp to advertise its cars at a suburban Detroit movie theatre -- not on the Big Screen, but in the parking lot outside and with displays throughout the theatre, the New York Times said.
In Monday's edition, the Times said a 6,000-seat, 20-screen Sony theatre in Southfield, Mich., is the test site for the new advertising technique.
Consumers who flock to the theatre will see cars on display outside and car-oriented advertisements inside, such as a display showing Elvis with the Corvette he drove in the movie, "Clambake."
"It is incumbent upon us to find new and fresh ways to engage" consumers, said Phil Guarascio, GM's general manager of marketing and advertising.
